summary: JPS Health Network, Tarrant County's safety-net health system in Fort Worth, Texas, identified suspicious activity in its network early on August 3, 2026 and took systems offline. The outage lasted about two weeks: staff used paper forms, phone lines and prescription refills were disrupted, ambulances were diverted, and the core EHR was not restored until August 14, with MyChart back on August 16. On October 5, 2026 the VYPR ransomware group claimed the attack on its leak site and threatened to release stolen data. JPS has not confirmed ransomware or data theft.
